name: Patung Penjaga Area Utama Mandala
sam3_prompt: Balinese stone guardian statue in a temple courtyard
description: A stone guardian figure associated with the Utama Mandala, the innermost sacred court of a Balinese temple. Its individual name and history remain unverified.
history: The available record does not confirm this figure’s exact site or date. This presentation stays with what can be responsibly said: a guardian form, carved in stone, with an uncertain individual story.
cultural_meaning: At temple entrances, guardian figures can stand to either side of a gate. Their placement signals protection and marks the passage into a more sacred space.
